title: I tried Gemini Spark in Chrome and it's the perfect AI for handling all the boring bits online
excerpt: Gemini Spark in Chrome is Google's most useful AI yet
content_html:
As soon as I heard that Gemini Spark was now part of the Chrome browser I had to try it for myself.

Gemini Spark is an AI agent designed to take on longer-running tasks that continue in the background. It's much smoother now thanks to an update that incorporates the platform directly into Google's Chrome browser. So now the AI can actually browse the web alongside you, doing its own tasks, instead of simply talking about it, even if you close your browser.

Before you can try Spark, you need the right ingredients. You will need the latest version of Google Chrome on Windows or macOS, a personal Google account, and either a Google AI Pro or Google AI Ultra subscription. With the right subscriptions, you just need to set Safe Browsing to either Standard Protection or Enhanced Protection before Spark becomes available.

With those requirements out of the way, click the three dots in the upper right corner of Chrome and choose Settings, then AI Innovations or Gemini in the Chrome menu, where you can navigate to the Permissions section and switch on the Let Gemini browse for you option.

Now you can open the Ask Gemini panel at the top of Chrome and give it a task that benefits from browser access. Spark will show you its proposed plan before doing anything, and the first time you use it, Chrome will ask whether you want to connect your browser to Spark. Click Allow or Connect, and from then on you can start handing Spark more ambitious jobs.

If something involves making a purchase, entering sensitive information, or confirming an important action, Spark pauses and asks for your approval before continuing.

The video below shows you exactly how Spark works:

I first decided to see how the AI did at the often time-consuming but important chore of comparison shopping. I asked Gemini using Spark to find a good deal for a TV.

Sign up for breaking news, reviews, opinion, top tech deals, and more.

Instead of asking which television I should buy, I gave Spark a proper assignment. I told it to compare prices for a 65-inch model at Amazon, Best Buy, Costco and Walmart, look for promo codes, and calculate the final price after discounts then prepare for checkout.

Spark didn’t just provide a summary. I could watch the AI navigate to different websites, try out different options, and work out which I might prefer.

When it found what it believed was the best option, it added the television to the cart and stopped, waiting for me to approve the purchase before doing anything involving payment.

Spark is happy to do the repetitive work, but it won’t spend your money without asking first. It feels like exactly the right balance between useful automation and common sense.

Planning a family day out

My second experiment was slightly more ambitious because it combined several different tasks into one. I asked Spark to plan a family day out for two adults and two toddlers.

Normally that would have meant switching constantly between Google Maps, museum websites, restaurant reviews and booking pages. Spark simply got on with it. It compared opening hours, checked travel times, built a schedule that actually flowed logically through the day, found a restaurant with online reservations and reserved it, then prepared the museum ticket purchase and before asking me to approve the bookings.

AI for tedious tasks

Google claims Spark is great at filling out paperwork, especially using information from your own Google accounts. As my kid is getting to the right age for it, I asked Spark to fill out his library card application.

After checking that it had the right information about my address and other details, Spark opened up my library's website and went to work. It filled in my contact information, mailing address and other saved details. When it reached the final submission page, it stopped and waited for my approval instead of clicking the button itself.

It’s not an incredibly long form, but it’s easy to see how Spark could save quite a lot of time on the more complex medical or insurance papers. It’s a lot faster to review and make sure the AI got it right than to write it all out yourself.

Using Spark highlighted how different it feels from regular Gemini. Spark shifts the workload because it can actually interact with the browser instead of simply describing what I should do next.

Gemini Spark is one of the more compelling AI features Google has introduced in quite some time. It won’t replace every online task, but it can quietly eliminate a surprising amount of clicking, tab juggling and repetitive typing.

在尝试 Spark 之前，您需要正确的成分。 您需要 Windows 或 macOS 上最新版本的 Google Chrome、个人 Google 帐户以及 Google AI Pro 或 Google AI Ultra 订阅。 通过正确的订阅，您只需在 Spark 可用之前将安全浏览设置为标准保护或增强保护。

满足这些要求后，单击 Chrome 右上角的三个点并选择“设置”，然后选择 Chrome 菜单中的“AI Innovations”或“Gemini”，您可以在其中导航到“权限”部分并打开“让 Gemini 为您浏览”选项。

现在，您可以打开 Chrome 顶部的“询问 Gemini”面板，并为其分配一项受益于浏览器访问的任务。 Spark 会在执行任何操作之前向您显示其建议的计划，并且在您第一次使用它时，Chrome 会询问您是否要将浏览器连接到 Spark。 单击“允许”或“连接”，从那时起您就可以开始向 Spark 交付更雄心勃勃的工作。

如果某件事涉及购买、输入敏感信息或确认重要操作，Spark 会暂停并请求您批准，然后再继续。

下面的视频向您展示了 Spark 的具体工作原理：

我首先决定看看人工智能是如何完成通常耗时但重要的比较购物的工作的。 我让 Gemini 使用 Spark 寻找优惠的电视。

订阅突发新闻、评论、观点、顶级技术交易等。

我没有问我应该买哪台电视，而是给 Spark 分配了一个适当的任务。 我告诉它比较 65 英寸型号在亚马逊、百思买、好市多和沃尔玛的价格，寻找促销代码，计算折扣后的最终价格，然后准备结账。

Spark 不仅仅提供摘要。 我可以观看人工智能导航到不同的网站，尝试不同的选项，并找出我可能更喜欢的选项。

当它发现它认为是最佳选择时，它将电视添加到购物车并停下来，等待我批准购买，然后再进行任何涉及付款的事情。

Spark 很乐意做重复性的工作，但它不会在没有事先询问的情况下花你的钱。 感觉就像有用的自动化和常识之间的完美平衡。

计划家庭外出一天

我的第二个实验稍微雄心勃勃，因为它将几个不同的任务合并为一个。 我请 Spark 为两个成人和两个幼儿计划一次家庭外出日。

通常，这意味着在谷歌地图、博物馆网站、餐厅评论和预订页面之间不断切换。 Spark 就这样继续下去。 它比较了开放时间，检查了旅行时间，制定了一个实际上在一天中逻辑合理的时间表，找到了一家可以在线预订的餐厅并预订，然后准备购买博物馆门票，然后要求我批准预订。

人工智能处理繁琐的任务

Google 声称 Spark 非常擅长填写文书工作，尤其是使用您自己的 Google 帐户中的信息。 由于我的孩子已经到了适合读书的年龄，我请斯帕克填写他的借书卡申请表。

在检查了有关我的地址和其他详细信息的正确信息后，Spark 打开了我图书馆的网站并开始工作。 它填写了我的联系信息、邮寄地址和其他保存的详细信息。 当它到达最终提交页面时，它停下来等待我的批准，而不是单击按钮本身。

这不是一个令人难以置信的长表格，但很容易看出 Spark 如何在更复杂的医疗或保险文件上节省大量时间。 审查并确保人工智能正确比自己全部写出来要快得多。

使用 Spark 突显了它与普通 Gemini 的感觉有多么不同。 Spark 改变了工作负载，因为它实际上可以与浏览器交互，而不是简单地描述我下一步应该做什么。

Gemini Spark 是谷歌在相当长一段时间内推出的最引人注目的人工智能功能之一。 它不会取代所有在线任务，但它可以悄悄地消除大量的点击、选项卡操作和重复打字。
